notes.text: config/settings.py was split: the defaults now live in config/engine.py (detection knobs), config/scoring.py (SCORE_*/TIER_*), config/enrichment.py, config/archive.py, config/market_data.py, config/market_context.py and config/runtime.py. settings.py re-exports them by name and stays the ONE namespace: consumers keep 'from config import settings', and scoped overrides setattr config.settings. A branch that adds or changes a knob puts the value in the owning domain file and adds the name to that file's import list in settings.py.

main.py no longer defines the lifespan handler; it lives in app/lifecycle.py.
The ibkr/ package (a re-export __init__ plus three modules) is gone; the modules live in domains/ibkr/ and domains/ibkr/__init__.py re-exports the same two names.
